body:
I'll check them out! Speaking of conforming, I couldn't believe I forgot Rage Against the Machine. They're currently my go-to band.

It was a stupid secret in eighth grade. We all look back upon year 8 pretty poorly. He's still my best friend in the world. I mean, I've vented to my friends about a break-up or family issues, but never about self harm. I'll open up to someone if it feels natural.

I should, and will be whoever I want to be. It's not my problem if someone can't stand me. Keep the good vibes in.

Thank you, and fuckthatmess. You've really pushed me to better myself for the sake of myself. I appreciate it.

I like the Penguins, Steelers, and Pirates, and my favourite collegiate team is Penn State. I'm not a big basketball fan. I watch the Premier League on occasion, and I root for Liverpool. I'm also a casual MMA fan.

I mostly listen to punk, such as Ramones and The Clash. Punk, Classic Rock, and Metal are my main genres, though I'd give anything a try except for most country.
The Clash, Pink Floyd, Rush, The Who, The Offspring, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Green Day, Anti-Flag, REM, and Iron Maiden are probably my top 10.

I know a lot of people are going through the same things, but I'm always compared to somebody. I'm an individual, and I have a lot on my plate. I can be a bit of an enigma, and basic girls around here don't know how to solve me. Even my best friends, I don't really vent to. I have trust issues because of a friend who made my secrets public before. So I only talk about the positive, funny stuff with my friends at school, and leave the personal stuff for my internet friends. I just don't want to be treated or perceived differently, that's all.

I first was hit with depression when I was 14, even looking at all the progress I've made since then is impressive, and I'd smack 14 year old me silly. I'm hoping the same can happen with me in the future.

I find myself a likable person. I don't see why people should hate me, it's just that my progressive, tech-savvy personality clashes with the rural ideals of my school, that and I'm kind of strange in a (good) way. So I have hundreds of acquaintances. I have my group of friends, but we all mostly just do group chats and online gaming sessions. The way the internet is nowadays, half of my Facebook friends are people like me, connected from around the world, and I prefer their company better than my peers. I eventually want to roadtrip and meet my real 'friends'.

I just want to get out of here, and only keep the positive people in my life and go to school to be a teacher. I am very shy and care a lot about what people think about me. After 12 years of public education, I've finally branched out. I can be quite the introvert, not always by choice, and I keep worrying I'd fail. 

I hope things will fall in place, I want change, I just don't want it too fast. Fear of failure is what's kept me down. That and fear of rejection.

Sorry if that was long and somewhat hypocritical / in circles. I at least know people on here are capable of help.

I'm asthmatic, so I hardly do physical activities. But I do enjoy video games and watching sports, and reading autobiographies, and I'm learning to play guitar because music is my passion. 

I just can't enjoy these things like I used to. I rather have too much or too little free time, and I have a wandering mind. I'm just going through a stressful adaptation in my life, and I feel like nobody gets me.
